verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Canny publishes its own MCP server, which external AI clients such as ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor connect to. That is the server role, not this client-side story, so it earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack shows Canny itself (including its AI Autopilot feature) letting users plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. Because a SaaS product with AI features could plausibly act as an MCP client, the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
